content.title: Continuous Escape Threshold Chain | Pursuit, Access Passage, Megastructure Reveal
content.summary: A polar engineer outruns a frost plume through an airlock into a telescope shaft. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult escape identity and one pursuing threat remain distinct. + Every breached surface changes the same route. + Doors and panels are motivated thresholds, not decorative cuts. + Travel direction and recurring corridor marks preserve geography. + The final space increases danger instead of falsely resolving it.
quick_start.recommended_input: Follow one adult polar observatory engineer retreating through a narrow white service tunnel while a rolling frost plume advances behind. The engineer reaches an exact AIRLOCK sign and performs one visible palm scan. Emergency amber rings illuminate the shaft and hold the engineer between the closed route and the larger hazard.
required_anchors: One adult escape identity and one pursuing threat remain distinct.
Every breached surface changes the same route.
Travel direction and recurring corridor marks preserve geography.
The final space increases danger instead of falsely resolving it.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A polar engineer outruns a frost plume through an airlock into a telescope shaft. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
